round: Facial expressions follow the words (Janna AR, Janna EN, Bassem): final design after the anam, language and regression reviews, 2026-11-20. Nothing written to Anam, the repository or the live site.

fallback.order: step1 first, step2 only after it; decide on the console cue log (DIRECTOR_NOTE_CUE_APPLIED), not on the look alone

step1.what: prompt edit: apologies move from [concerned] to [supportive]; [concerned] stays only for sympathy with a visitor or member who says they are upset or tired
step1.when: the pained look comes back only on apology sentences, and the cue log shows 'concerned' there
step1.send: systemPrompt alone (= the fallback file), expectedUpdatedAt from a fresh read, after the owner's OK, no call running

step2.when: the face is still pained, sad or exaggerated (eyes closing, drawn brows) on calm sentences while the cue log shows warm or supportive applied there
step2.send: directorNotes alone, per persona that shows it

rejected_review_points.point: stage the round with Janna EN first (no call history), or send dynamicDirectorNotes false in a second write after a check
rejected_review_points.decision: staged, but Janna AR first; no dynamicDirectorNotes write at all
rejected_review_points.why: the flag is no longer changed (review anam, blocker), which removes the risk an EN-first canary guarded against; Janna AR is the persona the owner complained about and will test, and her first-visit calls run on the saved persona, the one path where cue application is confirmed; Janna EN has had no calls, so testing her first would not exercise the complaint

rejected_review_points.point: cap wording «٣ بالكتير قبل الأداة و٣ بالكتير بعد نتيجتها» / "3 before a tool and 3 after its result"
rejected_review_points.decision: used the Anam review's wording instead: «٣ بالكتير في الرد، وتاج أول جملة بعد الأداة مش محسوب منهم» / "the tag on the first sentence after a tool never counts toward that limit"; the mixed-news rule of the same point is taken
rejected_review_points.why: same effect (the tag after the tool is never dropped), one count per reply, at most 4 face changes instead of 6, and no notion of "before the tool" for replies without one

rejected_review_points.point: follow-up Worker pull request: reframe the seven bracket markers without square brackets, and KNOWLEDGE_BLOCK in the feminine «ماتنفّذيش»
rejected_review_points.decision: deferred (listed in rationale.md section 10); the prompt sentence of the same point ships now
rejected_review_points.why: this workflow writes no repository code and deploys nothing; it is a Worker change deployed by deploy-worker

rejected_review_points.decision: «دافئة» kept for Janna AR; Bassem keeps the Egyptian «دافي»
rejected_review_points.why: the reviewer's own condition: «[دافئة]» is the stray tag the model actually wrote (twice), and the gloss exists to map that word to [warm]; the gloss is never spoken

rejected_review_points.point: [warm] bullet with «(«يا رب دايماً بخير»)» and «حضرتك ساكت بقالك شوية»
rejected_review_points.decision: partly: «ودعاء» and «ولما يسكت شوية («لسه معايا؟»)» are in; the two extra quoted examples are not
rejected_review_points.why: length (each prompt already grows about 2,000 characters); «ولما يسكت شوية» names the situation of #25, #37 and #51 in her own words, and «ودعاء» removes the 'invitations' reading

rejected_review_points.point: the exact layout of the split tool-turn example ("Example style (call the tools right after the first line…)" / '"…" + الأداة، وبعد نتيجتها: "…"')
rejected_review_points.decision: taken in substance with another layout: "A tool turn (the first line and the tool calls in the same reply; the second line only after their result, and only from it):" followed by one quoted utterance per line
rejected_review_points.why: keeps every example a single quoted utterance that apply_patch.py can check (starts with a tag, at most 3 tags, none at the end)

write_order: (the owner's test call, cue log on desktop Chrome)
test_gate: Before the next persona and before any later change: in a test call on desktop Chrome, a DIRECTOR_NOTE_CUE_APPLIED event (MIG_LIVE_CLIENT.client.addListener(anam.AnamEvent.DIRECTOR_NOTE_CUE_APPLIED, function (e) { console.log('cue', e.cueTag); })) for every spoken reply, and anam_session_search text '[' over the test window finds no persona message. If the returning-visitor (ephemeral) call shows one of the five tags in its transcript, or no cue events, hold Bassem's write (all his site calls are ephemeral) and raise it with Anam.
